our_changes: claude-code/router/: Rust port of scripts/jev_router.py (same Jev questions, thresholds and state files); ~90 ms per hook vs ~350 ms for Python on Windows, and it runs on Windows
claude-code/scripts/run.sh: hooks run the Rust router when fetched, else the Python one
claude-code/scripts/fetch-router.sh + SessionStart hook: download the router binary for this plugin version from this fork's releases
claude-code/scripts/jev_router.py: Windows file locking (msvcrt) when fcntl is missing; upstream crashed on every hook on Windows
User-facing messages from the Rust router are in English (upstream: Chinese); the Jev question text is unchanged
.github/workflows/release.yml: builds and tests the router on Windows, macOS (arm64, x64) and Linux; tags attach binaries to the release
plugin.json: version 0.3.0, repository and homepage point at this fork
how_to_sync: git fetch upstream && git merge upstream/main; port any change to scripts/jev_router.py into router/src/main.rs; then update synced_commit, synced_version and synced_on
